title: Tahoe Lake Tours
specs: Visit Emerald Bay, DL Bliss, Rubicon Bay, Meeks Bay, and other coves
See Fannette Island, Vikingsholm, Eagle Falls, and Rubicon Point
Boat is a 26' Formula 260 Bowrider with U-shaped lounge seating and open bow seating
Boat has enclosed restroom, wet bar, ice chest, Bluetooth and SiriusXM stereo
Captain is licensed (Master 100 ton) by the United States Coast Guard
Children 12 years and under must wear personal flotation devices at all times
Maximum capacity up to 6 passengers per private group
includes: Boat, fuel, and licensed Captain/Guide included
Life jackets for all ages and sizes provided
blurb: Guests board a 26' Formula powerboat for private sightseeing tours around Lake Tahoe. Tours include visits to Emerald Bay, DL Bliss, Rubicon Bay, Meeks Bay, and other coves. Options include swimming stops, picnics, and viewing landmarks like Vikingsholm and Fannette Island.
extraNote: Cancel 24-hours in advance or due to weather for 100% refund, no charge · Tahoe Keys Marina
